name: email
description: Email channel for Claude Code: each agent gets its own email address, in your firm's mailbox or on your server's own mail server. Mail arrives as a chat, the agent answers in the same thread, and a first mail to someone new waits for your tap.

verbs.name: email
verbs.summary: give an agent its own email address

local_only.label: Email to an outside mail server
local_only.note: Agents read and send no mail through an outside server from now on. A mail server on the office network still works.

cards.send: {agent} wants to email {sender}, who has never written to {agent}. The mail waits until you answer.
cards.receive: {sender} emailed {agent} for the first time. {agent} has not seen it. Let it through?
